name: finance-close
description: Finance Close — monthly standalone and consolidated financial statements for the Aistra group

scripts.dev: node scripts/dev-preflight.mjs && npm run build:packages && npm run db:start && npm run db:setup && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n shared,engine,api,web,ready -c gray,magenta,blue,green,cyan "npm run dev -w @finance-close/shared" "npm run dev -w @finance-close/engine" "npm run dev -w @finance-close/api" "npm run dev -w @finance-close/web" "node scripts/dev-ready.mjs"
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @finance-close/api -w @finance-close/web
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
